text: By the Perron-Frobenius theorem, a matrix with strictly positive entries has a largest-modulus eigenvalue that is:
choices: a complex number with positive imaginary part
a positive simple eigenvalue with a positive eigenvector
equal to the trace of the matrix
explanation: Perron-Frobenius gives a unique real positive dominant eigenvalue (the Perron root), simple, with a strictly positive eigenvector. This underlies topological entropy of SFTs and PageRank.
